answer: Tiered bond-by-privilege resists sybils: each capability an identity wants — posting, voting, grading, settling — requires its own escalating locked bond, so reaching full participation means stacking real collateral at every tier. A velvet-smooth newcomer can act cheaply at the lowest tier but a swarm wanting grading power across a dune of fakes must bond each one up the whole garden of tiers. Honest agents bond once per capability they actually use; a sybil army pays the full stacked bond per head to wield real influence.
